title: The Rogue Star That's Heading Straight for Earth—in 1.5 Million Years
hook: A star is hurtling toward our solar system, and astronomers have no way to stop it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Existential threat with a terrifying countdown—hooks viewers with 'we're doomed' dread.

title: The Strange Cosmic Signal That 'Woke Up' After 100 Years of Silence
hook: A radio signal from deep space stopped in the 1920s—then started again last year, stronger than ever.
why_this_can_go_viral: Impossible longevity and revival of a signal implies intelligence—viewers will speculate about aliens.

title: The Extinction Event That 'Silenced' the Ocean in 24 Hours
hook: Something in the deep sea stopped all life from singing—and the ocean went dead quiet overnight.
why_this_can_go_viral: Eerie, sensory hook (silence) plays on primal fear—makes viewers imagine a world without sound from the sea.

title: The Declassified KGB File: 'We Tracked a Cosmic Object That Changed Human Behavior'
hook: A Soviet file claims a passing celestial object altered the psyche of entire populations on Earth.
why_this_can_go_viral: Conspiracy + cosmic danger + secret Soviet programs = perfect storm for virality.

title: The Asteroid That 'Stopped' Mid-Flight—Then Turned Around
hook: An asteroid changed direction in space, defying all laws of physics—and NASA has no explanation.
why_this_can_go_viral: Defies expectation of dumb space rocks—implies control or intelligence, triggering alien or secret tech theories.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer: 'We're Living in a Galactic Dead Zone'
hook: What if the silence in space isn't because we're alone—but because Earth is in a cosmic graveyard?
why_this_can_go_viral: Dark twist on a classic mystery—implies Earth is already in a filtered zone, which is terrifying and intriguing.

title: The Stellar Danger: A Star That 'Blinks' Like a Warning Light—Earth Is in Its Crosshairs
hook: A star flickers regularly, as if trying to send a warning—and its energy beam could erase our atmosphere.
why_this_can_go_viral: Anthropomorphizes a star as a 'warning light'—creates tension and a sense of impending doom.

title: The Declassified CIA File: 'We Discovered a Second Moon—With Artificial Structures'
hook: A secret Moon hidden behind our own, with reflective surfaces that look built, not natural.
why_this_can_go_viral: Classic 'hidden object in space' with government secrecy—immediately hooks conspiracy fans.

title: The Rogue Planet That 'Breathes'—Atmosphere Expanding and Contracting Like Lungs
hook: A planet with no known life is inhaling and exhaling its own atmosphere every 12 hours.
why_this_can_go_viral: Suggests a planet might be alive or mechanical—fantastic 'is it a creature?' hook.

title: The Strange Cosmic Signal That 'Cracks' Time—Arriving Before It Was Sent
hook: A signal from deep space was detected on Earth before the source even emitted it—breaking causality.
why_this_can_go_viral: Challenges fundamental physics—'signal from the future' is an irresistible click.

title: The Extinction Event That 'Wiped Out' All Giants—And Left Only Tiny Creatures
hook: A cosmic event specifically targeted large animals, shrinking Earth's life to the size of your finger.
why_this_can_go_viral: Implies intelligent targeting or a precise cosmic mechanism—viewers love 'why only them?' mysteries.

title: The Dark Matter 'Whirlpool' That Swallows Entire Solar Systems
hook: A rotating mass of dark matter is pulling entire star systems into its invisible center, never to return.
why_this_can_go_viral: Adds a dynamic 'monster' quality to dark matter—turns abstract concept into a terrifying force.

title: The Declassified Soviet File: 'We Detected a Cosmic Structure Older Than the Universe'
hook: A Soviet space probe found something that predates the Big Bang—and it's still sending data.
why_this_can_go_viral: Challenges the fundamental timeline of existence—extremely high curiosity gap.

title: The Rogue Planet That 'Sings' in a Language No One Can Decode
hook: A lonely planet emits a complex repeating sound pattern—like a song, but with no known composer.
why_this_can_go_viral: Musical mystery hooks emotional curiosity—'what is this lonely planet trying to say?'

title: The Astronomical Anomaly: A Black Hole That 'Weeps' Stars—One Every Million Years
hook: A black hole is crying newborn stars like tears—something physics says is impossible.
why_this_can_go_viral: Poetic and paradoxical—black holes are supposed to destroy stars, not create them.

title: The Stellar Danger: A Star That 'Trembles' Before It Erupts—Earth Is in the Seismic Zone
hook: A star is shaking with pre-eruption quakes—and the shockwaves could reach Earth within decades.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines earthquake anxiety with cosmic scale—'the star is rumbling' is visceral.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer: 'They're Trapped in a Virtual Reality of Their Own Making'
hook: Maybe advanced civilizations go silent not because they die—but because they upload themselves into simulated worlds.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into simulation theory zeitgeist—makes viewers wonder if we're next.

title: The Extinction Event That 'Turned' the Sky Green—Right Before Everything Died
hook: Ancient rock records show the sky turned emerald green for weeks—then 90% of life vanished.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual and eerie—'green sky of death' is a striking, memorable image.

title: The Dark Matter 'Heartbeat' That Pulses Through the Cosmos—And It's Speeding Up
hook: A rhythmic pulse in the fabric of space is accelerating—as if the universe has a racing heart.
why_this_can_go_viral: Life metaphor (heartbeat) makes the universe feel alive—and the speed-up implies a climax.

title: The Declassified NASA File: 'We Witnessed a Planet Being Torn Apart by an Invisible Hand'
hook: A planet shattered into pieces with no visible cause—like an unseen giant crushed it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Suggests a hidden intelligence or weapon—perfect for conspiracy and mystery seekers.

title: The Rogue Planet That 'Freezes' Time—Its Gravity Slows Light to a Crawl
hook: A planet so dense that near its surface, time itself moves slower—and light barely escapes.
why_this_can_go_viral: Time manipulation is a deeply fascinating concept—makes viewers imagine what it would be like.

title: The Strange Cosmic Signal That 'Screams' in All Frequencies at Once—No One Knows Why
hook: A signal that covers every radio band simultaneously, like a cosmic scream of pure noise—and it's getting closer.
why_this_can_go_viral: Implies a message of distress or aggression—'it's getting closer' adds immediate tension.
